name: Louis Dreyfus Company
desc: One of the four 'ABCD' agricultural traders, merchandising and processing grains, oilseeds, cotton, sugar, rice, coffee and juice worldwide.
products: Grains, oilseeds, cotton, sugar, rice, coffee, juice, fertilisers, freight
customers: Food and feed processors, mills, refiners and manufacturers
marketing_autonomy_basis: Operating group itself; group-level corporate communications
markets: Trades in more than 100 countries across the Americas, Europe, Middle East, Africa and Asia
fit_rationale: A low-profile ABCD trader with a 45% Abu Dhabi sovereign shareholder; F1 hospitality in Abu Dhabi, Saudi, Brazil and China would serve its processor and government relationships in its key origination and destination markets.
f1_markets: Brazil, US, China, Netherlands, Abu Dhabi, Saudi Arabia, Australia, Singapore

access.roles: Chief Corporate Affairs Officer; Head of Communications

compliance: Page reports 2011 Argentine tax-evasion allegations (about USD 1bn), denied by the company.
outstanding: Current revenue (FY2024/25) not on an opened page; figures are FY2018; employees figure is 2015 peak-season

name: Froneri
desc: Ice cream maker formed by Nestlé and PAI Partners, producing Häagen-Dazs, Dreyer's, Drumstick, Oreo and Rowntree's ice cream across six continents.
products: Branded and private-label ice cream and frozen desserts
pe_swf_owner: PAI Partners (50%); ADIA investor (per WSJ citation)
marketing_autonomy_basis: Separately managed JV with its own brand portfolio and licences
markets: UK, continental Europe (Italy, France and others), the United States, Australia and New Zealand (Peters, Tip Top)

fin.value_orig: EUR 1.4bn investment by PAI and ADIA

signals.what: EUR 1.4bn investment from PAI Partners and ADIA valuing Froneri at EUR 15bn (WSJ, cited on page)

fit_rationale: Ice cream brands such as Häagen-Dazs and Drumstick suit summer Grand Prix sampling and fan-zone retail; fresh ADIA/PAI capital gives budget for pan-European and US brand building.
category_conflict: potential: Nestlé (KitKat) is an F1 partner and Froneri's 50% owner; Magnum Ice Cream Company not checked
f1_markets: UK, Italy, US, Australia, Spain, Netherlands, Austria, Belgium

access.roles: Chief Marketing Officer; Brand Director Häagen-Dazs

outstanding: Revenue on Wikipedia (GBP 750m) is undated and outdated; Rabobank figure is an estimate; confirm Nestlé marketing approvals

name: Agropur
desc: Farmer-owned Canadian dairy co-operative producing milk, cheese and ingredients under brands such as Natrel, Oka and Québon.
products: Fluid milk, cheese, dairy ingredients, ice cream
customers: Retailers, food service and food manufacturers
distress: November 2025: closure of Edmonton ice cream plant, 137 lay-offs (per Wikipedia)
fit_rationale: Canada's largest dairy co-operative could use the Canadian Grand Prix in Montreal, near its Quebec home, for retail promotions of Natrel and Oka and for trade hospitality.
outstanding: Confirm US operations from company page; 2021 revenue is the latest reported figure opened

name: Refresco
subsector: contract bottling of soft drinks and juices
desc: World's largest independent bottler, producing private-label and contract-packed soft drinks and juices for retailers and brand owners.
products: Private-label and contract-manufactured soft drinks, juices, waters
customers: Supermarket private labels and A-brand beverage owners
minority_investors: PAI Partners; British Columbia Investment Management Corporation
stores_or_sites: 72 sites in Europe and North America plus 3 in Australia
markets: Europe (about 60% of 2023 sales), North America and Australia
profitability_basis: Net result EUR -25m in 2025, EUR -304m in 2024; operating result EUR 227m 2025

signals.what: Bid of USD 0.8bn for all shares of SunOpta

compliance: Wikipedia notes a groundwater permit dispute at the Maarheeze plant
